## [The usual fix]{.h2-kicker}One more standard for everyone to follow. {#usual-fix}

[Filing standard · rev. 7]{.cl-rev}

[Before you save a file, please:]{.cl-head}

- Check the data's home hasn't moved since you last looked.

[Hashes]{.cl-sec}

- Hash the values, not the file:
   - read every column in order; count the rows and the columns
   - fold every NaN to one bit pattern; turn −0 into +0
   - keep NA apart from NaN, and from an empty string
   - write numbers little-endian, whatever the machine
   - re-encode all text as UTF-8
   - ignore row names, and tibble vs. data.frame

[· · ·]{.cl-more}

- Refuse unsupported columns: list every one, before touching anything.
- Never store per-column hashes: they could give the values away.
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 72%"}
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 54%"}

[Parquet]{.cl-sec}

- Save as parquet. Hash those exact bytes too, separately.
- Already stored? Don't upload it again: that would break its integrity hash.
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 66%"}
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 80%"}

[· · ·]{.cl-more}

[Version log]{.cl-sec}

- Nothing changed since the last version? Skip it.
- Never write a table over a set with the same name.
- Record each parent at its exact version and hash.
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 58%"}
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 76%"}
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 48%"}

[Manifest]{.cl-sec}

- Update the manifest.
- Commit and push first. Upload to storage after.
- Mirror the manifest to storage, from the committed copy.
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 70%"}
- []{.cl-scrawl style="width: 62%"}

"The usual fix is one more standard for everyone to follow. Here's what this one would ask of you, every time you save a file."

0:25.

Don't read the list; its length is the point. The lines are real: every one is a step datom takes inside `datom_write()`.

Click: the sheet pulls back, and it keeps going. "Every file. Every time. By hand."

Then the bridge, and advance as you say it: "Nobody would do that. And even if they would…"
